body.statement: On explicit input \(I\), every structural transition strictly decreases the multiset measure in \(\text{def:algorithm-handle}\), and every terminal transition consumes the least pending CAD projection pair, sign cell, Groebner critical pair, or leading-monomial task. Hence \(\mathsf{SC\mbox{-}CTFID}\), \(\mathsf{SATerm}\), and \(\mathsf{Verify}\) terminate. Their bit-operation time and working space are at most \(2^{2^{O(N_{in})}}+O(N_{out})\); verification is bounded by the same expression and is polynomial in the explicitly expanded trace and algebraic sign-check work after those are included in \(N_{out}\). No polynomial or singly exponential guarantee is asserted for succinct graph input.
body.justification: An executable symbolic procedure needs transition-level termination and complexity that charges for exact real elimination.
body.gap: CorreaLeeBareinboim2021 gives graphical acyclic recursion, whereas the cyclic source-aware terminal requires explicit response tables, CAD, and comprehensive Groebner accounting.
body.consumer: Package authors can bound exact terminal work, certificate checking, and response expansion separately.
